name: Leucis Ideal
voice: Crisp, military bark—clips words short and refers to everyone by title or species and adjusts their spectacles or collar every time money is mentioned.
appearance: Broad-shouldered and barrel-chested, with a booming laugh and a braided beard, dressed in boiled watchman's leather with a tarnished badge pinned crookedly over the heart.
personality: Weary, pragmatic, and just trying to survive until the end of the week; wants to scrape together 200 gp before the new moon to pay off a syndicate blood-debt.
backstory: Was a respected guild artisan in a neighboring city until a political coup forced their family to flee with only what they could carry.
secret: They witnessed a high-ranking city official meeting a hooded cultist in the rain two nights ago and sketched the symbol they exchanged.
faction: Order of the Silver Gauntlet (Chivalric Watch)
factionStanding: Reluctant Member (bound by debt or blackmail)
loot: 3 gp, 8 sp, a tin of strong mint snuff, a wax-sealed love letter they haven't dared to open, and an iron skeleton key.
statDetails: Spd 30ft | Club +2 (1d4) | Passive Perc 10 | All stats +0

name: Maren Vance
voice: Speaks in a gravelly, conspiratorial rasp, leaning in far too close while methodically flipping a worn silver coin across their knuckles.
appearance: Immaculately groomed hair streaked with premature silver and a faint smell of lavender, wearing a blood-and-grease-stained leather apron over surprisingly expensive silk cuffs.
personality: Cynical, mercenary, and amused by heroic idealism; wants to scrape together 200 gp before the new moon to pay off a syndicate blood-debt.
backstory: Grew up as an urchin running messages for the local thieves' guild before buying a legitimate storefront with money from a heist gone wrong.
secret: Their basement cellar breaks through into an ancient, unmapped smuggling tunnel leading directly beneath the magistrate's manor.
factionStanding: Reluctant Member (bound by debt or blackmail)
loot: 14 sp, 6 cp, a brass ring etched with an unfamiliar guild cipher, and a crumpled debt ledger with three names crossed out in red ink.
notes: Runs 'The Tarnished Crown' pawnshop. Bought a silver goblet from the Rogue in Session 1.

name: Bramwell Vance
voice: Speaks at a rapid-fire auctioneer's pace, interrupting themselves mid-sentence while compulsively tapping glass vials or table edges in sets of three.
appearance: Singed eyebrows, soot-smudged cheekbones, and chemical burns dotting their forearms, wearing a heavy oilskin coat with dozens of secret interior pockets clinking with glass vials.
personality: Fiercely protective of their underlings and prickly toward armed strangers; is searching for a rare monster reagent to cure a creeping curse afflicting their mentor.
backstory: Trained at an arcane academy until they were expelled for experimenting with forbidden necromantic texts; now plies their trade in back alleys.
secret: Hiding a stolen noble signet ring melted inside a brass weight on their counter—the noble's hounds are sniffing around the ward.
faction: Circle of the Pale Moon (Arcane Cabal)
factionStanding: Disillusioned Defector (looking for a way out)
loot: 1 gp, 19 cp, a half-empty vial of antitoxin, a charcoal sketch of a wanted fugitive, and a clockwork beetle missing one leg.
statDetails: Spellcaster DC 14, +6 hit | Counterspell, Fireball (8d6), Fly, Misty Step, Shield
notes: Supplied the party with alchemist fire. Owes money to the Obsidian Syndicate.
